issues.en: Child's name "Пзефъ" probably Józef, left as written. Mother's maiden name garbled. End of the parents line is cut.

issues.en: Beginning of the baptism line (year, ыаяча ... К тага) is garbled. The word for the parents' estate is missing. Godmother's name and her husband's surname garbled.
issues.lt: Tėvų luomo žodis eilutės pradžioje neišlikęs; motinos vardas parašytas „Прасильды“; krikštamotės vyro pavardė neįskaitoma.

issues.en: The estate word is garbled (варянъ), read as peasants; father's name Алексянъдра read as Aleksander. Village name garbled. Child's name Filemena left as written (perhaps Filomena).
issues.lt: Luomo žodis išlikęs tik dalimi („варянъ“, gal „Дворянъ“); kaimo pavadinimas neaiškus.

issues.en: Child's name written "Бардара", rendered as Barbara. Date "вадцатьвасьмага" read as 28th. Godmother's name Гозамен garbled. Surname from the margin (entry reads Салевъ).
issues.lt: Kunigo pavardė perskaityta „Паиткевичемъ“; krikštamotės vardas ir jos vyro pavardė neaiškūs.

issues.en: Margin has Asinskikh [?], entry text has Iassinskikh; treated as one name, margin form used. Child's second name garbled (Apolinary?). Mother's maiden name cut off (Symonovska).
issues.lt: Pavardė įraše „Яссинскихъ“, paraštėje „Ас[с?]инскихъ“; motinos mergautinė pavardė neaiški.
